Für das Konto speichern wir Deine E-Mail: For the account we store your email address and, if you set one, your password as an encrypted hash. Logging in with a code sends you a one-time code by email. The session stays stored on your device so you remain logged in.
Rechtsgrundlage ist die Erfüllung des Nu: The legal basis is the performance of the user agreement (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Wir speichern Deinen Decknamen, Dein Pro: We store your alias, profile picture, form of address, neighborhood (as text, for example “Prenzlauer Berg, 10435 Berlin”), your settings and the times you agreed to these terms.
Zu Challenges speichern wir Titel, Text,: For challenges we store title, text, photos, place as text, deadline, coins, status and a point rounded to about 100 metres. Plus comments, likes, private operation names and groups including membership.
Andere angemeldete Personen sehen Deinen: Other logged-in people see your alias, profile picture, neighborhood, challenges and comments. Challenges in groups are only seen by group members. Photos are stored at a public address. Anyone who knows this address can open the photo without an account.
Dein Standort bleibt auf Deinem Gerät: Your location stays on your device
Gibst Du den Standort frei, ermittelt De: If you share your location, your phone works out the district, postcode and street from it. It uses the operating system’s location service (Apple on iPhone, Google on Android). KiezCoins doesn’t store your exact location. Only the neighborhood as text and, for challenges, the rounded point are stored. Your phone calculates distances in the feed itself.
In der Web-App fragt Dein Browser Kiez u: In the web app your browser asks OpenStreetMap for neighborhood and street (Nominatim service of the OpenStreetMap Foundation, United Kingdom). For this it only sends the point rounded to about 100 metres and, for technical reasons, your IP address. The basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) and the EU adequacy decision for the United Kingdom.
Die Freigabe ist freiwillig und lässt si: Sharing is voluntary and can be withdrawn at any time in your phone’s or browser’s settings. Without sharing you enter your neighborhood by hand.
Kontoinhaberin oder Kontoinhaber, IBAN u: We only store the account holder, IBAN and PayPal address if you enter them. They are private. For coins you share them with exactly the person who pays you the coins. KiezCoins doesn’t process payments.
Meldest Du eine Person oder Challenge od: If you report a person or challenge or write to support, we store your message in order to handle it. The reported person doesn’t find out who reported. If you block a person, we store whom you blocked. If you give praise, we store whom you praised. Others only see the count, not who praised. To protect against abuse, our hosting service keeps technical logs with IP address and time for a short period.
Rechtsgrundlage ist unser berechtigtes I: The legal basis is our legitimate interest in safe, fair operation (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) and handling reports under the Digital Services Act (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).

Die Idee hinter KiezCoins ist, dass Mens: The idea behind KiezCoins is that people are happier and healthier when they cooperate and build robust social networks. That requires mutual respect. Es gelten die Community-Regeln. Du stell: The community rules apply. You only post challenges, photos and comments you’re allowed to post. Für das Anzeigen in der App räumst Du un: For display in the app you grant us a simple, free right to your content. For content of a public shop window, this right also covers the page on kiezcoins.de and search engines. It ends when you delete the content or your account.
